decisions.reason: It is a direct replacement of a proven analog input module and builds squarely on the firm's analog and firmware know-how, so absorptive capacity is high and withdrawal is unlikely.
The MQTT proxy leverages the firm's existing software bindings, API generation, and connectivity expertise, enabling it to interpret results and improve the product.
CAN bus builds on the firm's communication protocol knowledge and the firm can assimilate the protocol stack through R&D, though it is somewhat less core.
CO2 sensing uses sensor integration and calibration knowledge related to existing sensing modules, but the earlier withdrawal of the indoor air quality sensor raises some uncertainty about this line.

The touch panel accessory is less central because it requires UI/display capabilities outside the firm's core modular-hardware knowledge, so absorptive capacity is weaker and there is moderate uncertainty.
